title: Fast Roots
description: Remodels Mangrove Roots for better performance.
body:
This is a small resource pack that does only one simple thing: it remodels the Mangrove Roots block to use the column block base instead of the custom model it originally has.

This makes the block use less faces and therefore improves performance (especially in Mangrove Swamps).
You can see what the roots look like with the pack active in the images section.
This pack is also compatible with resource packs that retexture the Mangrove Roots.  It is NOT compatible with those that remodel them.

Please enjoy!
